implementation_summary: Added a source-only standard-library Git-index measurement tool, focused deterministic coverage, and a canonical accepted-baseline candidate. The report inventories tracked worktree bytes in stable path order, records physical text/binary metrics and SHA-256 identities, aggregates category totals, reports largest UTF-8 text files and the AGENTS.md plus Orchestrator checkpoint bootstrap footprint, and labels resolvable Markdown links/code-span paths as static structural references rather than observed runtime context.

architecture.source_boundary: tools/repository_context.py is outside src/agent_governance, governance-core, governance-skill, and the explicit T020 Consumer artifact inputs.
architecture.inventory: git ls-files --cached selects tracked paths; the tool reads current worktree bytes, handles symlinks and non-UTF-8/binary content deterministically, and records source_git_revision plus a tracked_content_digest over ordered path/content identities.
architecture.determinism: Sorted paths and edges plus compact sort-key JSON produce byte-identical output for unchanged tracked content. baselines/repository-context-source-v1.json and an in-repository output path are explicitly excluded to prevent self-reference.
architecture.measurement_semantics: Raw bytes are canonical. Character, line, and Markdown heading counts exist only for UTF-8 text. Static resolvable local Markdown links and code-span paths are structural graph evidence only and are explicitly not observed RFO, TMC, CAR, token counts, or runtime loads.
architecture.enforcement: Measure-only operation has no size budget, warning threshold, split/refactor behavior, document mutation, network access, or Consumer runtime effect.

acceptance_evidence.result: PASS: canonical inventory ordering, repeated in-memory/output identity, source revision, content-digest sensitivity, baseline exclusion, and stable CLI output are asserted.
PASS: binary and unusual UTF-8 handling are asserted; output declares observed_runtime_context_metrics false and contains no token_count/RFO/TMC/CAR metric fields.
PASS: exact AGENTS.md and docs/orchestrator/CHECKPOINT.md physical-byte sum and file inventory are asserted without a target or enforcement threshold.
PASS: source-only placement is asserted; T020 exact payload allowlist and artifact-only seven-command execution remain green.
PASS: all fixture Markdown bytes remain unchanged across writes and a 1 MiB text file is measured successfully as the largest file without failure or enforcement.

git_status: Verified source tool/tests are committed at implementation_head_sha. The accepted baseline and this handoff are finalized together in a metadata successor commit after measuring the staged final handoff; the interactive completion reports the pushed successor HEAD.
risks: source_git_revision records the current HEAD while tracked_content_digest identifies measured staged/worktree content; parent should regenerate the accepted baseline if any measured tracked file changes before commit.

Structural Markdown references intentionally cover only resolvable local inline links and code-span paths to tracked files; they do not claim comprehensive prose references or observed context loading.
